findings.title: A successful location create/edit in the building workspace raises 'Save changes before leaving?' and hides the success receipt
findings.trigger: Storage-layout manager on /master-data/storage-layouts/<buildingId>: More actions > Add storage stack > Create storage stack, and the write succeeds. The same happens for edit-from-map (?editZone=<id>) > Save changes.
findings.expected: The editor closes and the existing receipt ('Storage stack created…' or 'Storage stack updated…') is shown. No unsaved-work prompt appears: nothing is unsaved and the write has settled.
findings.actual: The mutation is sent once and the editor closes. Then a modal 'Save changes before leaving? You have unsaved changes…' opens, even for a pristine default-name create. The URL keeps ?overlay…=1. 'Keep editing' leaves the editor closed with the overlay query still present (a stale foreground entry). 'Save and continue' sends 0 extra writes and closes. The success receipt is never rendered. No saved data is lost.
findings.evidence: rendered-component-test: probes/storage.probe.tsx 'SS-05 …' cases (real BuildingModelWorkspace, Dialog, useBackDisclosure, useWorkflowStep and useNavigationGuard; mutation mocked to succeed). 4 desired-behavior cases fail; 2 observation cases pass, recording 0 extra writes. Cause is a source-traced hypothesis: the Dialog closes and its Back step runs in the same commit that clears the child's pending flag, while the workspace guard's pending is still true because it is propagated through two layout-effect/state hops. The hidden archive receipt is source-traced only. Not browser-verified.
findings.recommendation: Have the workspace guard read child pending state live (a synchronously updated ref, like childDrafts.latest), or close the editor through the disclosure/operation completion owner after pending settles. Render the success message outside the selected-zone gate, or select the newly created location. Add caller tests in StorageLayoutScreens.test.tsx: compact create/update success with no prompt, receipt visible, overlay entry consumed, next Back normal (EN/TH, plus archive). Run pnpm check:navigation.

findings.title: Building/review/task routes say 'Choose a warehouse' but render no warehouse selector
findings.trigger: A member with 2 or more accessible warehouses and no stored selection (new device, cleared storage) opens a direct building, review or finished-goods task link.
findings.expected: The page that instructs 'Choose a warehouse to see its work and records.' offers the selector, then renders the requested record on the same URL.
findings.actual: The panel 'No warehouse selected / Choose a warehouse…' renders with 0 warehouse-select controls. The control case on the catalogue route renders the selector. The user must go through the sidebar to the catalogue, choose there, and find the record again, losing the deep link. If a different accessible warehouse is stored, the backend returns found:false and the page shows 'Storage building not found.' with no hint to switch.
findings.evidence: rendered-component-test: probes/shell.probe.tsx 'SS-01 …' renders the real shell Pattern and QueryGate with mocked useWorkspace (2 warehouses, none selected). Detail route: 0 selectors (fail). Catalogue control: selector present (pass). The other-warehouse found:false path is source-traced. Not browser-verified.
findings.novelty: new (13 Oct row 02 judged warehouse scoping sound and did not cover missing-selection recovery)
findings.recommendation: When selectedWarehouseId is undefined and the member has warehouses, render the existing selector as the WAREHOUSE_MISSING panel action (QueryGate) or in TaskWorkspaceContext. This keeps the intended rule of no switching on detail pages once a warehouse is chosen, and does not widen F05 because no draft exists in this state. Test: deep link, choose warehouse, same URL renders, with locale/query/hash preserved.

findings.title: Building/review not-found and read-failure states render a bare notice with no heading, Back/breadcrumb or retry
findings.trigger: Open /<locale>/master-data/storage-layouts/<id> or …/<id>/review when the layout read returns found:false (deleted, mistyped, or in another warehouse) or ok:false.
findings.expected: A page heading, Back/breadcrumb to the declared parent (catalogue; the building for review), a short explanation, and Retry for a read failure.
findings.actual: Only 'Storage building not found.' or 'The storage layout could not be loaded.' is rendered: 0 headings, 0 links, 0 buttons. Recovery depends on browser Back or the sidebar.
findings.evidence: rendered-component-test: probes/storage.probe.tsx 'SS-02 …' renders the real StorageBuildingEditor/StorageBuildingReview with useStorageBuilding mocked to found:false or ok:false; 3 cases fail. Route pages and backend found:false are source-traced. Not browser-verified.
findings.recommendation: Wrap non-ready states in PageHeader with the existing breadcrumb parent, add Retry for !ok and a not-found body naming the selected warehouse with a link to the catalogue. Review navigation inventory targets and run pnpm check:navigation. Add caller tests for both routes: heading, parent Back, direct link, Retry.

findings.title: Unfiltered empty building catalogue says 'No buildings match these filters'
findings.trigger: Open /<locale>/master-data/storage-layouts (empty search, All statuses) in a warehouse with no buildings. This is the default landing page after sign-in.
findings.expected: First-use empty state: 'No storage buildings yet / Create a building to start defining floor-by-floor capacity.' (TH 'ยังไม่มีอาคารจัดเก็บ…'). Filter-mismatch copy only when a filter is applied.
findings.actual: EN 'No buildings match these filters / Change the search text or status filter…'; TH 'ไม่มีอาคารที่ตรงกับตัวกรอง'. The first-use keys are unused.
findings.evidence: rendered-component-test: probes/storage.probe.tsx 'SS-04 …' renders the real StorageBuildingCatalogue with useQuery returning an empty ready page; EN and TH cases fail. No t('emptyTitle') caller in src (git log -S points to 983fb5a6). Not browser-verified.
findings.recommendation: Use emptyTitle/emptyBody when search is empty and status is ALL. Otherwise keep noMatches and add Clear filters. Add an EN/TH render test for both states.

findings.title: The workspace bar says 'No organization context' for a member with an organization but no accessible warehouse, and while loading
findings.trigger: A signed-in organization member whose scoped membership has no ACTIVE warehouse opens the storage or finished-goods catalogue; or any user while the workspace query loads.
findings.expected: Zero warehouses: 'No warehouse available' plus advice to ask an administrator; the page does not say 'Choose a warehouse'. Loading: a neutral loading state.
findings.actual: The bar shows 'No organization context / Organization and warehouse access comes from your verified account.' and the page shows 'No warehouse selected / Choose a warehouse…'. While loading, the bar also shows 'No organization context'.
findings.evidence: rendered-component-test: probes/shell.probe.tsx 'SS-03 …' renders the real WorkspaceContextBar and QueryGate with mocked workspace states; 2 cases fail. Zero-warehouse reachability is source-traced in convex/workspace/current.ts (scoped ACTIVE filter); no fixture creates such a member. Not browser-verified.
findings.recommendation: Split the WorkspaceContextBar early return into loading, organization-missing and zero-warehouse branches (reuse 'noWarehouses' plus an administrator hint). Give QueryGate a distinct no-access state when warehouses.length === 0. Add EN/TH tests.
